text:
alex.cheng: kicked off the Sherpa sweep on raven-lite-int8 build across the toolchain harness. short summary: structured-action responses start failing parse at tail-end about 7.8%.
maria: can you dump an example of the offending payload?
alex.cheng: here —
```
{"action": "create_ticket", "args": {"title": "Bug in onboarding", "metadata": "line1\nline2"},}
```
sam: ah trailing comma + unescaped newline in metadata field. looks like tokenizer splitting at kvcache boundary leads to stray comma sometimes. similar to previous kvprefix truncation but new pattern.
jess: which model config? kv cache length / prefix packing?
alex.cheng: sherpa run used: model=raven-lite-int8, kv_prefix=1024, batch=32, prefix_trunc=off, compile=kCustomFast. Canary saw failures concentrated at sequence length > 800.
deploy-bot: Canary report: total=4,200 requests, schema_pass=92.2%, parse_fail=7.8%, median_latency=48ms
maria: retry logic currently does 2 retries, exponential backoff 200/500ms. did you see if retries succeed or still fail?
alex.cheng: 65% of parse_fails succeed after 1 retry with relaxed parse (strip trailing commas). remainder are non-json tails.
sam: potential mitigations: 1) postprocess strip trailing commas and attempt ndjson split; 2) force model build to use conservative tokenizer boundary; 3) enable prefix-escape sanitizer in runtime that closes open braces when cutoff.
jess: can we quantify downstream impact? e.g. percent of tool-invokes that go to fallback vs silent drop?
alex.cheng: quick metric: of failing calls, 40% hit fallback route (simple text->fallback), 25% drop to error pages, rest retry loop.
maria: ok let's do an experiment: 1) enable postprocess healer (+strip coma +ndjson split) 2) reduce kv_prefix to 768 and rerun 10k samples 3) add parse-logging for first 10k failures and sample tokens. assign owners?
alex.cheng: i'll own 1 and 2, sam will own logs + analysis, jess to update canary dashboard.
sam: also add a small prompt wrapper to ask model to close JSON before stopping: "Please output valid JSON only. If truncated, close the JSON object." might reduce non-json tails.
alex.cheng: noted. timeline: rerun tomorrow morning, will post fresh stats.
jess: :thumbsup: thanks
maria: thanks all — appreciate quick turn
